title: A refund PayPal made never reached the books

step.title: PayPal refunded two orders. The shop's books still say paid.

ring.label: Cannot auto-heal: the event is not in PayPal's list (it shows up 80 to 163 s late)

lines.text: await ctx.books.set(booking.captureId, { state: booking.state, amount: booking.amount, eid: event.id, at: ctx.now() });
lines.shown: await ctx.books.set(booking.captureId, { state: booking.state, amount: booking.amount, eid: event.id, at: ctx.now() });

cause.explanation: A changed line answers PayPal before the booking work is finished, so that work can be lost after the 200.

replay.expectation: Both builds answer 200; the good build books the events, the bad build books nothing.

fix.claim: Behaves like the good build and PayPal's answer on these 15 inputs (3 orders x arrival order, reversed, tampered).

hunks.text: // Maple Mug webhook handler. PayPal posts here when a payment is captured or refunded.
// Never move an order backwards: a late "paid" must not undo a "refunded".
await ctx.books.set(booking.captureId, { state: booking.state, amount: booking.amount, eid: event.id, at: ctx.now() });

checks.label: The edits name changed lines of the diff, and replace or delete only lines the cause cited.
It uses only the imports and names a handler may use.
Lines of the bad deploy that the cause did not cite are unchanged, byte for byte.
The edits stay inside the bad deploy's changed hunks.

controls.label: The events in the order they arrived: same answers and same books as the good build.
The same events, last one first: same answers and same books as the good build.
One amount in each body changed: 401 and nothing booked, like the good build.
The books equal PayPal's own answer for the order (GET capture).

certificate.header: 2 of 3 captures did not match PayPal (2 answered OK but the books do not match PayPal) · $96.00 across 2 refunds not in books · checked 3 of 3 captures.
limits: 3 rows are inside PayPal's event-list lag (median about 80 s, up to 163 s measured): an event missing from the list proves nothing yet.
certificate.footnote: Orders that were approved but never captured cannot be counted (PayPal has no list API for them). An event that is not in PayPal's event list cannot be shown to have existed. Transaction Search lags about 97-128 minutes, so the last 2 hours of transactions were not used. This certificate is not signed: anyone could edit it.
ownerView: We checked 3 of your 3 orders against PayPal's own records.
